cases.assertion: acquire, renewal, expiry and generation replacement use exact tuple/revision CAS; an old token cannot renew
a released lease prevents both external dispatch and local checkpoint completion
capture epoch, generation or configuration replacement makes old dispatch and completion stale
a worker fenced during its fake external call returns a stale namespaced artifact and cannot complete local live state
opaque external namespaces change with epoch, generation, anchor and configuration without exposing destination identity
a current anchored lease may allocate a monotonically increasing local promotion intent; stale leases cannot prepare one and M2 executes no selector
fresh monotonic time is sampled after external and local callbacks; expiry classifies artifacts stale and rolls local completion back
a substituted namespace, ownership loss, and adapter failure cannot dispatch or complete live state
empty identities, zero generations or TTLs, and integer/expiry overflow fail closed
